title: Introducing: Shopify and Dynamics 365 Business Central (2023)

chapters.title: Introduction to Business Central and Shopify integration
Integration with Microsoft Office productivity tools

features.name: Shopify integration with Business Central
features.description: Business Central integrates seamlessly with Shopify stores to manage backend operations, inventory, and financials. Orders from Shopify flow directly into Business Central for fulfillment.

features.name: Automatic inventory synchronization
features.description: Business Central keeps inventory levels in Shopify stores up to date automatically, syncing product information between systems.

features.name: Automatic order fulfillment
features.description: Orders from Shopify shops flow directly into Business Central, allowing users to focus on other tasks while fulfillment is automated.

features.name: Multi-location warehouse management
features.description: Support for multiple warehouse locations allows optimization of warehouse processes to reduce delivery times and handle specific business needs like returns.

features.name: Financial visibility and reporting
features.description: Revenue from Shopify stores is automatically reflected in Business Central, providing a 360-degree view of financials, expenses, profits and tools for tax reporting.

features.name: Microsoft Office integration
features.description: Business Central integrates with Microsoft Office productivity tools including Teams for collaboration on orders, Outlook for customer communication, and OneDrive for document storage and sharing.
